reviews.text: They gave me a discount for when i had to let my ferret go when i couldn’t afford it. They gave me time to grieve and even offer to get checked out n pay private. Wonderful people❤️‍🩹 …

I’m so glad I found this clinic after moving to Dallas. Everyone here is incredibly kind and knowledgeable, and they always make my senior dog feel comfortable and well cared for. I especially appreciate how they explore different treatment options rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach. My dog had been struggling with some difficult-to-pinpoint issues, and their recommendation of ketamine and vitamin B therapy has made a noticeable difference in his quality of life. Scheduling is always easy, too. I genuinely feel at ease knowing he’s in good hands.
Amazing vet! They work with many pugs and nare surgery for them.
Wonderful staff, very attentive,  professional, caring, and you can feel the Love for animals at this Hospital. Forever my favorite animal Hospital 🏥 💙 💓

Do not board your pets here. Ive taken my pets here over the span of six years and it has been awful every time. The first time we boarded my dog here, he came home with kennel cough.

When I took my cat in to be seen as he was having severe GI issues, the head doctor delivered the devastating, run around news that he had cancer while apathetically and loudly eating her lunch. Imagine getting the news that your baby is dying and the head of office can't put down her chips for five seconds to show some compassion. So gross.

The worst of all was that over the 6 years of boarding my ferret here, there is always a problem being brought to my attention last minute.

On multiple occasions, my ferrets toys/bowls/blankets have been unaccounted for upon pickup. Recently, our blanket smelled like dog, which made it seem like they take your things to use in other kennels which is unsanitary.

Three years ago, they raised their rate from $35 a night to $44. No big deal, but we weren't informed beforehand when we boarded him.

Two years ago, they decided to start requiring appointments in advance, and earlier this year updated their policy to include an additional $150 dollars for extra shots and preventative care. We were informed of both of these policies last minute. Not sure why, because we got his annual shots and tests done every time prior to his stay, and you would think if you're updating policies you would make sure to communicate that ahead of time.

Additionally, because their staff is so poorly trained and there is no communication, they charged us almost triple our stay cost because we brought his own raw food. It was ultimately their mistake, which they corrected, but it would have been avoided had the front desk knew what they were doing.

The last interaction was the final nail in the coffin. We called in advance to set up an appointment for his boarding as per policy; and every time ask if they need anything from us. Ferrets are obligate carnivores, which means their diet is best with only meat. We have raw fed our ferret for years, and have provided him food for each stay, packaged and labeled. Apparently, they decided to randomly claim a day before our vacation that our raw food was an OSHA violation, and we can no longer feed him and have to switch to kibble. Our ferret does not eat kibble, so we had to scramble hours before our flight to make sure he had his food taken care of.

The front office communication is piss poor. They are constantly rotating out of staff because of their high turnover rate and I guess the office manager just doesn't care to train them.

I will never take my ferret back here.
Just received a sympathy note, including Darby’s foot prints that we’ll keep forever. Class act. Customer for life!!
Best vet in Dallas!

I used to come here and see Dr. Martin when I lived in Dallas and loved him. I moved away and found a closer vet, but when I found out my dog had a suspicious tumor I came back because I trust this office so much. Dr. Kores helped us through this process from start to finish. She was so thorough, patient, and kind. The entire office truly loves animals and I do not think they over charge for things you don’t need. Highly highly recommend!
Thank you for the 5-star review! We always love to see Tucker! - The Vickery Place Animal Hospital Team
We have always had the best care here!  Everyone truly cares about us and our animals.

I bring my ferrets here and Dr. Martin and Dr. Kores are amazing. They listen to your concerns and even when it seems unlikely, they explore all options with your concerns in mind. They are compassionate and helpful and will give you all options available. They don't just give you the most expensive treatment options, but let you know what the best diagnostic options are and all scenarios. Price is always talked about up front as well. You can compare and assess what is going to work best for you. I've had a ferret treated for DIM, even when he was outside of the normal age range of ferrets affected and not all of the symptoms were indicative of it so it didn't seem that was the likely cause, Dr. Martin listened and we started the treatment for it and my ferret made a 100% improvement. I'm also currently dealing with a ferret diagnosed with insulinoma and Dr. Kores has been very supportive and helpful. I've also unfortunately had to put a ferret to sleep at Vickery and the doctors and staff were amazing. They even light a little rainbow lamp at the desk so other patients are aware.
The vets and staff are GREAT people.  They work in tandem with an organization I belong to, DFW Pug Rescue.  They are always friendly and helpful when I bring in a Pug for a checkup or evaluation.
Thank you for the 5-star review! - The Vickery Place Animal Hospital Team

I cannot say enough amazing things about Vickery Place Animal Hospital! From the moment we walked in, the staff made both my dog, and I feel completely comfortable and cared for. Everyone was incredibly kind, patient, and genuinely passionate about helping my pet get well again.

Dr. Thompson and the veterinarians took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answered all of my questions, and made sure I understood my dog’s condition and future care plan. They treated my dog like one of their own, and that meant a lot to me. It’s clear they truly care about the well-being of every pet that comes through their doors.

I’m so grateful to have found a place I can trust with my dog’s health. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care!

They were professional, knowledgeable, answered questions. They were concerned and considerate of our needs as well. Gave us all the knowledge and tools to care for our animal on our own, after they did a fantastic job themselves. I couldn't have asked for a better outcome. These people, we need them and they are good.
First time meeting Dr martin. Could not have been more impressed. He absolutely put my mind at ease.
Very helpful and understanding.
This place rocks. Kayla helped get Pongo in dog day care with documentation.

Finding a vet you can trust is hard! We have a senior cat who has had a multitude of issues. Vickery Place was amazing at addressing our concerns, being available to answer our questions, and never once made me feel as if I was overreacting to the little things. When he needed surgery, they helped us find the right vet for the job and were a huge support in recovery. They helped us with our new puppy as well. They were often able to help us find time last minute, even when it was for a kitten I found on the side of the road who desperately needed care! We have since moved out of state and I miss the care and kindness they gave our pets and us.
Caring staff, very informative and pleasant experience every time we go.

They took amazing care of our kitten!  From start to finish it was a great experience.  They had complimentary canned drinks.  Rheanne and Patrick were S+ tier at thoroughly evaluating our kitty and making him comfortable as well.  They have treats for the animals, we have found our vet for life.  ❤️
This is the very best care for your animals. Very caring, loving people

I visited this clinic 2 weeks ago explaining the issue my dog was facing with her ear. They sent me home saying it was allergies and gave her an allergy shot. 2 days later I reached out again to the place explaining my concern with her shaking her head non-stop and was told to wait for the medication to work. Now I have a dog with blood in her ear and they won't accept to see me if I won't pay another consultation. Very disappointed with the care provided to my dog and wouldn't recommend this location.
Took me seriously. Was wonderful and thoughtful. Loved how cute and clean the place was. And they didn't try to overcharge or add services i didn't need or ask for! Will be coming back
The staff is always so nice and welcoming to both me and my pet.

I have brought all my pets here over the years (2 bunnies + 2 dogs) and have normally been pleased with their service. Dr. Martin & Dr. Miranne are excellent vets! What I think they can improve on is the service at the front desk.

I moved abroad a couple years ago and while overseas, I needed them to fill out an additional form in order for my dog to come back to the USA. Since CDC requirements changed while I was abroad, vets are required to retroactively fill out the form using the information in the animals chart. I reached out via a detailed email requesting this form. At first, all went okay. Then it became very obvious that they had never seen this form before. I reached out about the form on December 2. Lots of back and forth with them asking specific questions that were not needed for the form (ex. vaccines that had been given abroad, future address, etc that was not needed since it was supposed to be filled out retroactively). I paid for the form on December 12. December 17 I got sent a draft form that I had a couple small edits to. Form was updated and resubmitted same day. I heard nothing for weeks. I reached out January 13 for an update and was told Dr. Miranne was out of office. January 21 completed form was received. Almost 7 weeks to get one form completed. Sure it was the holidays but if the team was on top of it, it should have taken 1-2 weeks max.

All in all, this clinic has some great vets but needs to work on their client services.
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon- The Team at Vickery Place Animal Hospital
Thank you for the 5 star review - we are so glad we exceeded your expectations! If you need anything else, don't hesitate to reach out. - The Team at Vickery Place Animal Hospital

This is just one of those places you walk in and you know everyone truly loves animals. Which is always heartwarming when it comes to vet care.  We have been here a few times now and it’s always been top notch care for my babies. I can’t truly express how fantastic all of the staff has been. Taylor one of the techs is an absolute rockstar. Dr Max and Dr D are phenomenal as well. This is definitely a  place that hears your concerns as a pet parent and takes the time to walk you through everything.

I'd avoid them if possible. We had a pet having screaming seizures that they could hear over the phone. We were told if we couldn't get there before their staff meeting they wouldn't see her until it ended 2hrs later.
She would just lay there and seize for 2 hours.

Update to response,
Your team did not advise going to an emergency vet. We made the decision after being told the animal would have to wait until after your staff meeting.
Best vet practice ever! Taylor is a fantastic vet tech and loves on my dog every time.

I've been taking my dogs to Vickery Place for a few years now, so it's about time I wrote a review. I love taking my dogs to this vet clinic. They are so kind and always welcome you with a smile. My 4-year old beagle sees Dr. Martin and my 1-year old beagle sees Dr. Miranne. Both vets are truly incredible to work with and fit the personalities of my dogs so well, which really was just luck of the draw, but I'm very grateful for it. They are open and honest about treatment plans, quick to answer any questions, and truly seem to love the animals they work with. I don't often dread taking my dogs to the vet because I know they're in good hands here.

A glowing review wouldn't be complete without mentioning the veterinary assistant team. Briana, Taylor, and Emma are just a few who I've worked/talked with enough to be able to say how truly wonderful they are. I know I've met more than that and they've all been so lovely.

Finding a vet home for my dogs wasn't something I took lightly and I'm so glad we landed here. If you're not sure of where to take your pets, I would HIGHLY recomend Vickery Place.

Taylor and Dr. Martin (and the entire Vickery team) are amazing! They take great care of my dogs and are always showing them tons of love each time we visit, which makes each visit special! The Vickery team helped identify one of my dogs’ bladder cancer and took special care to refer us to an oncologist, while also making sure we were emotionally supported.

Bri, Izzy, Sammy, and Dr.martin were absolutely amazing with my sweet p! They took the best care of my Pomeranian and her anxiety was gone after a few pets from the vet! I cannot recommend this vet more. They were affordable while giving the best care. Best experience so far at a vet!!!

I have loved Vickery for the last 4 years! Had a bit of an emergency situation today and they were able to fit me in almost immediately. I appreciate the care that Taylor and Dr. Miranne gave my baby today. They have never steered me wrong!
Taylor is absolutely amazing! She goes above and beyond and Reggie and Luke love her so much

Most incredible experience with Dr. Martin and his assistant Taylor. I needed a same day appointment on a Saturday and they managed to fit me in! (no other vets ever do that!). Such a sweet, loving and friendly staff - you can tell immediately they really care about each animal that walks into their door. Will 110% be back!
Taylor and Dr. Martin were great! They took great care of my dog and were really nice to nephew that had to tag along. Best choice in the neighborhood!!!
